children: The total number of discovered mineralisation sites reached 5,680 by the end of 2025, according to official data from the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT).
This is an increase of 29 sites compared to 2024, GASTAT said in its latest Mineral Resources Statistics 2025 report.

Non-metallic mineral sites accounted for 53.98 percent, while metallic mineral sites accounted for 43.03 percent. Sites containing both metallic and non-metallic minerals accounted for 2.99 percent of the total discovered mineralisation sites.
The total number of valid mining licenses grew by 524 licenses to 2,925 in 2025.

Geographically, 58.91 percent of all valid mining licenses were concentrated in Riyadh Region, which accounted for 31.56 percent, Eastern Region for 15.62 percent, and Makkah Region for 11.73 percent.
Mining reserves of gold and base metals in the Kingdom amounted to almost 16.68 million ounces of gold, 1.85 million tonnes of zinc, and 0.72 million tonnes of copper in 2025.
Imports accounted for 30 million tonnes, representing 57.62 percent of the total last year, while exports amounted to 22 million tonnes, accounting for 42.38 percent, the report said.

title: Saudi Arabia reports discovery of 5,680 mineral sites in 2025
